# Copied from Chrome DevTools: "Copy as cURL (bash)". Don't edit by hand.
curl 'https://app.example.test/api/notes' \
  -H 'accept: application/json' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -b 'sid=abc123' \
  --data-raw $'{"title":"it\'s here","body":"line1\\nline2","tab":"a\tb","snow":"☃","hex":"\x41"}' \
  --compressed ;
# A hand-written command with a multi-line JSON body (the comment's apostrophe is harmless).
curl -X PUT https://app.example.test/api/notes/7 \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "title": "multi",
  "tags": ["a", "b"]
}'

curl -s https://app.example.test/api/notes?limit=2 | jq .
